data_gap.statement: Player-week statistics could not be obtained from a verifiable source inside this build environment.
evidence: nflverse release assets (player_stats_*, stats_player_week_*) live on release-assets.githubusercontent.com, which is blocked from the build sandbox (TLS failure recorded in COORDINATION.md).

Every reachable GitHub mirror of stats_player_week_*.csv was inspected and is a truncated or synthetic test fixture: Eric-Weng/CommishDesk contains team codes XXX/YYY and a fabricated player; Fibonacci-0112/NFL-360 is cut at 76 rows; balprab24/fantasy-kai ships a single-season fixture only.
data_gap.consequence: Player-prop baselines, prop lines and prop correlations are therefore NOT published as numbers. The site publishes the framework, the gates, the required sample sizes and the team-level anchors that a prop model must be consistent with.
data_gap.what_would_unblock_it: Any one of: (a) a player-week CSV export supplied directly, (b) an official league stats feed, (c) a licensed odds feed for closing prop lines.
